verses.text: Now gather your troops, city of troops, because an enemy has surrounded us. They will strike the ruler of Israel on the cheek with a rod.
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come for me one who will rule over Israel. His beginnings are from long ago, from ancient times.
So Israel will be abandoned until the time when the woman in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to join the people of Israel.

He will stand and care for his flock with the strength of the LORD, with the majesty of the name of the LORD his God. And they will live in safety, because his greatness will reach to the ends of the earth.
He will be our peace. When the Assyrians invade our land and march through our fortresses, we will raise up seven shepherds against them, even eight leaders.
They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, the land of Nimrod at its gates. He will rescue us from the Assyrians when they invade our land and march across our borders.
The survivors of Jacob will be among many nations like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for anyone or depend on any human being.

The survivors of Jacob will be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep. When it passes through, it tramples and tears them to pieces, and no one can rescue them.
Your hand will be lifted up in victory over your enemies, and all your enemies will be destroyed.
"On that day," says the LORD, "I will destroy your horses and your chariots.
I will destroy the cities of your land and tear down all your fortresses.
I will put an end to your witchcraft, and you will no longer have fortune-tellers.
I will destroy your carved idols and your sacred stones. You will never again bow down to what your own hands have made.
I will pull up your Asherah poles and destroy your cities.
In anger and fury I will take revenge on the nations that have not obeyed me."
